name: 10009 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10009 (New York) has 208 nonprofit organizations. 87 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 70 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10009 (New York) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 10009 (New York) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 53 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
